Subject: Evidence request: vulnerability closure for telemetry-sdk v1.4.2 (CVE-2026-1459)

Kimberly —

Following our SIG questionnaire review, Acme Pay needs: (1) the latest authenticated scan that shows no unresolved instances of CVE-2026-1459 in your hosted environment, (2) a short attestation of remediation steps and timelines for any residual findings, and (3) confirmation of any compensating controls currently in place. We flagged two hosts during our pentest that referenced telemetry-sdk v1.4.2. Please attach any closure logs and the date the fix was deployed.

A couple of constraints: our procurement team requires evidence dated within the last 45 days and an SLA exception if the fix needs more than 14 days.

Can you confirm scope (host list) and provide the artifacts by EOD Oct 5?

Thanks,
Alex
Security Lead — Acme Pay
attachments requested: acme_scan_20260930.csv (if available)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: 2026-10-01T12:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: vulnerability closure for telemetry-sdk v1.4.2 (CVE-2026-1459)

Alex —

Thanks for the clear ask. We confirm scope includes the two hosts you flagged (svc-infer-03, svc-logging-01) plus a third internal instance running batch telemetry (batch-telemetry-01) that uses the same dependency. We're working on the artifacts. Quick summary:
- Active mitigation already applied: WAF rule 17 (blocking the exploit vector) and network ACLs isolating telemetry endpoints from customer-facing routes.
- Planned remediation: upgrade telemetry-sdk to 1.5.0 (patch contains the backported fix) with staged rollout to avoid regressions.
- Timeline: can complete the staged rollout and verification within 10 business days (target 2026-10-13) unless we encounter a compatibility regression.

I'll attach the latest authenticated scan export and an internal closure log once the patch completes. If the rollout slips past 14 days we'll complete an SLA exception via DocuSign — I've looped Marissa to coordinate the exception paperwork.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

Alex / Kimberly —

Operational update and attached closure log: we completed the compatibility tests for telemetry-sdk 1.5.0 against our primary inference stack and a canary was deployed to svc-logging-01 on 2026-10-03 at 23:10 UTC. No regressions observed in metric ingest or tokenization paths. Full rollout to svc-infer-03 and batch-telemetry-01 is scheduled for 2026-10-11 (outside the canary window to minimize customer traffic impact).

Compensating controls (already enforced):
- WAF rule 17 active across the region (blocks CVE-specific payload patterns).
- Short TTL read-only staging replicas to limit lateral movement for telemetry ingestion.
- Alerting: internal pager rule on unusual telemetry ingestion patterns (PagerDuty PD-101).

Attached: cve-closure-log-20261004.pdf (contains per-host timestamps, patched package checksum, and verification steps). We will provide a signed SLA exception via DocuSign if the full rollout extends beyond Oct 15.

Regards,
